# --- FF dev-exclusion (CHANGES.md #2): index ONLY the organiser train list. Original two lines:
# ---     root = X.media_root(IN, WORKDIR / "raw")
# ---     S = X.index_splits(root)
# --- media_root unpacks every zip of the inputs (dev_set.zip too) and index_splits needs the four dev lists.
def _ff_train_root(inp, work):
    """flag_extract.media_root, restricted to the organiser train zip."""
    if next(inp.rglob("*.wav"), None) is not None:
        return inp
    zips = [p for p in sorted(inp.rglob("*.zip")) if p.name.lower().startswith("train_set")]
    assert zips, f"no .wav and no train_set*.zip under {inp}: attach the raw v4 dataset"
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for zp in zips:
        marker = work / f".{zp.stem}.done"
        if marker.exists():
            continue
        X.log("extracting", zp.name)
        with X.zipfile.ZipFile(zp) as z:
            z.extractall(work)
        marker.touch()
    return work


root = _ff_train_root(IN, WORKDIR / "raw")
S = {"train": X.resolve_split(root, "train_English.txt", 2, 3)}
for k, v in S.items():
    v["dur"] = np.array([X.sf.info(str(v["root"] / p)).duration for p in v["wav"]], dtype=np.float32)
    X.log(f"{k:20s} {len(v['wav']):5d} rows | dur median {np.median(v['dur']):.1f}s max {v['dur'].max():.1f}s")
